dct_description_sm: The CALON Team is currently making observations on 60 lakes in northern Alaska. The lakes are distributed along two parallel transects that extend from the Arctic Ocean to the Brooks Range Foothills. These transects consist of ten nodes where lake observations are conducted. The Eastern Transect includes lakes located near the Ikpikpuk Delta, Teshekpuk Lake, Lower Fish Creek, Inigok, Umiat, and Toolik Lake. The Western Transect includes lakes located near Barrow, Lower Meade River, Atqasuk, and Reindeer Camp. The goals of the project are the creation of a lake monitoring network and the collection of baseline data of physical, chemical, and biological lake characteristics.
dct_title_s: Circum Arctic Lakes Observation Network (CALON): Toolik, Umiat, Inigok, Teshekpuk Lake, and Ikpikpuk Delta, Alaska
